summary: Scans the live vehicle pointer array (dword_7C54F0, count dword_5C329C) for up to two vehicle ids: the primary id a1 and the secondary id a2, each read from vehicle+16480. When the primary id matches it draws a marker for that vehicle via sub_4D9690 at (a3, a4+160.0); when the secondary id matches it draws a marker via sub_4D9690 at (a3+64.0, a4-32.0). Returns 0 on every exit path, normally after both markers have been drawn or the scan is exhausted. Called from StartingGridUIDraw (004d9420), consistent with a starting-grid position-marker renderer.

operations.description: Precompute the primary marker Y position v10 = a4 + 160.0 before the vehicle scan starts.
Vehicle-count guard: if dword_5C329C <= 0 the scan is skipped entirely and the function returns 0.
Scan the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 from index 0 upward while the index is below dword_5C329C.
Read the vehicle id dword at offset +16480 of the current vehicle pointer into v8.
If v8 == a1 (primary id match), break out of the loop to draw the primary marker.
If v8 == a2 (secondary id match), draw the secondary marker at an offset position.
Compute the secondary marker position: v12 = a3 + 64.0 and v11 = a4 - 32.0.
Call sub_4D9690(vehiclePtr, secondaryX, secondaryY) to draw the secondary marker at (a3+64.0, a4-32.0).
Set v4 = 1 to record that the secondary marker was drawn.
After the primary id match breaks the loop, call sub_4D9690(vehiclePtr, a3, primaryY) to draw the primary marker at (a3, a4+160.0).
Set v13 = 1 to record that the primary marker was drawn.
If the secondary marker was already drawn (v4 set), return 0; otherwise resume scanning for the secondary id.
Return 0 when the scan index passes the vehicle count (scan exhausted) and on every other exit path.
